# Mission Canvas

> Custom software built around your business, with ongoing maintenance and agreed improvements. Start with one workflow and a clear scope of care.

Mission Canvas offers Customized Software as a Service: custom software built around a business workflow, with scoped maintenance and agreed improvements. Each engagement defines the build, costs, deployment and ongoing care. Book a workflow audit: https://pretendhome.github.io/audit/


## Main pages

- [Mission Canvas: Customized Software as a Service](https://pretendhome.github.io/): Custom software built around your business, with ongoing maintenance and agreed improvements. Start with one workflow and a clear scope of care.
- [Let’s talk about your workflow](https://pretendhome.github.io/audit/): Tell us about one recurring job. We will discuss a focused custom workflow, the first build and its ongoing care.
- [Custom software and ongoing care by industry](https://pretendhome.github.io/canvases/): Explore software for site and office records, clinic administration, invoices and other recurring work, with customization and ongoing care agreed.
- [Custom software and ongoing care: questions answered](https://pretendhome.github.io/faq): What Mission Canvas does, who it fits, how the first workflow walkthrough works, and what to know about cost, data and ongoing care.
- [How it works](https://pretendhome.github.io/how-it-works): Choose one important workflow. Build custom software around it, review real examples and keep it useful with ongoing care.
- [Palette: explore the desktop foundation](https://pretendhome.github.io/palette): Explore source-linked document work with Palette, a free desktop app. Custom workflow development and ongoing care are a separate Mission Canvas service.
- [Pricing: a focused build and ongoing care](https://pretendhome.github.io/pricing): A defined custom software build, recurring care and clear outside costs. We quote around the workflow your business needs.
- [Your data: know what the software can see and do](https://pretendhome.github.io/security): Choose the information your workflow uses, where it is processed and which actions need review. Keep those boundaries clear through ongoing care.

## Industries

- [Construction job costing and fleet software](https://pretendhome.github.io/canvases/construction): Construction job costing and fleet software for site and office teams: job records, delivery tickets and costs together, with care as forms and jobs change.
- [Private AI for schools: student lenses and parent summaries](https://pretendhome.github.io/canvases/education): Private AI for schools: connect classroom observations, student records and teacher-reviewed parent drafts, with formats and coursework adapted to your school.
- [Ticketing and access control software for venues](https://pretendhome.github.io/canvases/events-venues): Ticketing and access control software for venues: shared sales and entry records for box office and gate staff, with forms, entry rules and reports adapted to the event.
- [Private patient check-in and scheduling software](https://pretendhome.github.io/canvases/healthcare): Patient check-in and scheduling software in progress: scope the administrative handoffs for clinic staff, with access, review and ongoing care agreed before use.
- [Order tracking software for small logistics companies](https://pretendhome.github.io/canvases/logistics): Order tracking software for small logistics companies: help operations check stalled orders and prepare customer updates, with imports and connections scoped to the workflow.
- [Invoice processing automation for small businesses](https://pretendhome.github.io/canvases/office): Invoice processing automation for small businesses in progress: scope invoice checks, recurring requests and reviewer handoffs, with care as forms and rules change.
- [AI receptionist for small businesses: phone, WhatsApp, email](https://pretendhome.github.io/canvases/voice-front-desk): An AI receptionist for small businesses: routine bookings by phone, WhatsApp and email, with staff handover and ongoing care for your rules and service information.
